canonical_example.text: Consulté el problema con una experta en psicología.
canonical_example.translation: I consulted the problem with an expert in psychology.

canonical_example.text: No soy un hombre de negocios experto, pero parece una buena inversión.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not an expert businessman, but it sounds like a good investment.

canonical_example.text: Resultó que el conductor del taxi era de Cádiz, como yo.
canonical_example.translation: The taxi driver turned out to be from Cádiz, just like me.

canonical_example.text: Se hizo muy popular como conductor de las noticias de la tele.
canonical_example.translation: He became very popular as a TV news presenter.

canonical_example.text: El conductor del programa entrevistó a varios escritores nóveles.
canonical_example.translation: The host of the show interviewed several young new writers.

canonical_example.text: El agua es un buen conductor de la electricidad.
canonical_example.translation: Water is a good conductor of electricity.

canonical_example.text: La cerámica es un material conductor del calor, lo que explica muchas de sus aplicaciones.
canonical_example.translation: Ceramic is a heat conductive material, which explains many of its applications.

canonical_example.text: El pánico es un sentimiento imposible de controlar.
canonical_example.translation: Panic is a feeling that is impossible to control.

canonical_example.text: El psicólogo está tratando el miedo pánico que su paciente le tiene a la muerte.
canonical_example.translation: The psychologist is treating his patient's panic fear of death.

canonical_example.text: Los griegos antiguos eran politeístas y adoraban a dioses como Zeus y Apolo.
canonical_example.translation: The Ancient Greeks were polytheists who worshiped gods like Zeus and Apollo.

canonical_example.text: Se negó a renegar de su fe y adorar ídolos falsos.
canonical_example.translation: He refused to renounce his faith and adore false idols.

canonical_example.text: Si te duele la garganta, debes tomar té con miel.
canonical_example.translation: If your throat hurts, you should drink tea with honey.

canonical_example.text: Ese camino pasa por una garganta.
canonical_example.translation: That path passes through a gorge.

canonical_example.text: Cúbrete la garganta con una bufanda si sales.
canonical_example.translation: Cover your neck with a scarf if you go outside.

canonical_example.text: La garganta era más profunda de lo que recordaba.
canonical_example.translation: The ravine was deeper than I remembered.

canonical_example.text: La garganta atraviesa el sistema montañoso.
canonical_example.translation: The pass goes through the mountain range.

canonical_example.text: La garganta de la columna está adornada con hojas.
canonical_example.translation: The shaft of the column is decorated with leaves.
